newsitem.title: UK: SQUASH-JANSHER WINS BRITISH OPEN AFTER MARATHON.
newsitem.headline: SQUASH-JANSHER WINS BRITISH OPEN AFTER MARATHON.

text.p: Jansher Khan won his sixth successive British Open title on Sunday but only after the longest match of his career.
Scot Peter Nicol, the third seed, kept the top-seeded Pakistani on court for two hours six minutes before eventually succumbing 17-15 9-15 15-12 8-15 15-8.
Nicol was perhaps unlucky with his share of the 32 penalty strokes, 83 lets and 16 no-lets but was eventually worn down by Jansher.
"I have had tougher finals against the Australians in the past," said Jansher. "But Peter was playing better than ever before and the refereeing disturbed me."
"I have never had so many calls against me."
